name: The Hermit of Ash Hollow
blurb: A reclusive herbwife in a burnt-out hut knows what happened at the mill.
description: A small wilderness encounter: a guarded herbwife, a burnt hut, and a purse of hush-money.
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
premise: Mara Ash saw the miller's son set the fire that killed two workers, and the miller has paid her to keep quiet.
truth: Mara's grandchild works in the miller's kitchen. She took the money to keep the child fed, not to protect the miller.
gm_notes: Mara is not a villain. She is frightened and protective. She will trade the truth for a promise that the child will be safe. The miller's men may arrive while the bargain is being struck.
tone: Woodsmoke, wet ash, and a door that is never quite open.

cast.wants: Keep her grandchild out of the miller's reach.
cast.secret: She saw the arson and took hush-money.

places.secret: The child's wooden boat on the sill is the only sign anyone else lives here.

entries.name: Mara Ash
entries.description: A herbwife in her sixties, burned across one hand. She saw the fire and took the miller's money.
quirks: taps a finger against her lips when thinking

entries.name: Ash Hollow Hut
entries.summary: A low turf hut with a crooked chimney, set in a black ring of burnt stumps.
entries.description: The hut smells of peat smoke and dried yarrow. A child's wooden boat sits on the sill.

entries.name: The Miller's Purse
entries.summary: A purse of hush-money with the miller's mark on the clasp.
entries.detail: The coins are new and the purse is good leather. Mara did not spend it.
entries.reveals: The miller paid Mara to keep quiet.

entries.name: The Bargain
entries.summary: Mara will name the arsonist if the party can get her grandchild out of the miller's service.
entries.setup: Mara has already denied seeing anything. The child is in the miller's kitchen.
complications: The miller's men arrive while the bargain is being struck.
Mara's grandchild does not want to leave.
entries.if_ignored: The miller moves the child out of the region, and Mara stops speaking to strangers.
outcomes: Mara names the son; the party gains a witness.
Mara keeps silent; the purse is the only proof.
